mapper.select: SELECT MATERIAL_CODE CLOTH_CODE, /*帘带编号*/ CASE WHEN NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0) > 0 THEN NVL(S.STOCK_NUM, 0) - NVL(S.BAD_NUM, 0) + NVL(S.MODIFY_NUM, 0) ELSE 0 END STOCK_QTY FROM T_Cd90_STOCK S WHERE S.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND S.STOCK_DATE = #{scheduleDate} - 1 /*库存要取排产日上一天的*/
select param_code, param_value from T_XWYY_PARAMS where DEL_FLAG = '0'
select id, material_code, machine_code, nvl(trunc(stock_num), 0) stock_num from T_CD90_LINE_SIDE_STOCK where DEL_FLAG = '0' and stock_date = #{scheduleDate} - 1
select id, machine_code from t_cd90_machine_info where del_flag = '0'
